videoUrl.iframeSelector: (function(){function L(m){try{console.log('[MGP] '+m);}catch(e){}}function probe(tag){try{L(tag+' href='+location.href);var hasCfg=(typeof config!=='undefined'&&config)?'yes':'no';var cu='';var vk='';var nx='';if(typeof config!=='undefined'&&config){cu=String(config.url||'');vk=String(config.vkey||'');}L(tag+' config='+hasCfg+' url.len='+cu.length+' url='+cu.substring(0,60)+' vkey='+vk);var mv=document.querySelector('meta[name=viewport]');var mc=document.querySelector('meta[charset]');nx='vp='+(mv?mv.id:'NONE')+' cs='+(mc?mc.id:'NONE');L(tag+' meta '+nx);L(tag+' typeof decrypt='+(typeof decrypt)+' typeof CryptoJS='+(typeof CryptoJS)+' typeof $='+(typeof $));if(typeof decrypt==='function'&&cu){var d='';try{d=decrypt(cu);}catch(e){L(tag+' decrypt threw: '+e);}L(tag+' decrypt.len='+(d?d.length:0)+' val='+String(d).substring(0,100));}}catch(e){L(tag+' probe err '+e);}}function grab(){try{if(typeof decrypt==='function'&&typeof config!=='undefined'&&config&&config.url){var u=decrypt(config.url);if(typeof u=='string'&&u.indexOf('http')==0)return u;}}catch(e){}return '';}function post(u){try{window.animeBridge.onLink(u);}catch(e){}}probe('t0');var r=grab();if(r){L('sync hit');return r;}var n=0;var iv=setInterval(function(){var x=grab();if(x){clearInterval(iv);L('async hit n='+n);post(x);}if(n==3||n==10||n==30){probe('t'+n);}n++;if(n>=200)clearInterval(iv);},300);return 'PENDING';})()
